Anya: py streaming snippet: ```python
async for chunk in client.responses.stream("generate", input=prompt):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
Anya: py retry snippet: ```python
from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt
@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3))
def call():
    return client.generate(input)
```
Sam: ts streaming: ```ts
for await (const p of client.responses.stream("generate", { input: prompt })) {
  process.stdout.write(p.text)
}
```
Sam: ts retry util: ```ts
async function withRetries(fn, retries = 3) {
  for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) {
    try { return await fn() } catch (e) { if (i === retries - 1) throw e }
  }
}
```
Leo: go streaming: ```go
stream, _ := client.StreamGenerate(ctx, prompt)
for msg := range stream.Ch {
  fmt.Print(msg.Text)
}
```
Leo: go helper: ```go
for {
  m, ok := stream.Next()
  if !ok { break }
  fmt.Println(m.Text)
}
```
Jon: manual pagination (py): ```python
page_token = None
count = 0
while True:
    resp = client.list_items(page_size=50, page_token=page_token)
    for it in resp.items:
        print(it)
        count += 1
        if count >= max_items: break
    if count >= max_items or not resp.next_page_token:
        break
    page_token = resp.next_page_token
```
